name: iotthingsgraph
description: AWS IoT Things Graph AWS IoT Things Graph provides an integrated set of tools that enable developers to connect devices and services that use different standards, such as units of measure and communication protocols.

subcommands.name: associate-entity-to-thing
subcommands.description: Associates a device with a concrete thing that is in the user's registry.

subcommands.name: create-flow-template
subcommands.description: Creates a workflow template.

subcommands.name: create-system-instance
subcommands.description: Creates a system instance.

subcommands.name: create-system-template
subcommands.description: Creates a system.

subcommands.name: delete-flow-template
subcommands.description: Deletes a workflow.

subcommands.name: delete-namespace
subcommands.description: Deletes the specified namespace.

subcommands.name: delete-system-instance
subcommands.description: Deletes a system instance.

subcommands.name: delete-system-template
subcommands.description: Deletes a system.

subcommands.name: deploy-system-instance
subcommands.description: Greengrass and Cloud Deployments Deploys the system instance to the target specified in CreateSystemInstance.

subcommands.name: deprecate-flow-template
subcommands.description: Deprecates the specified workflow.

subcommands.name: deprecate-system-template
subcommands.description: Deprecates the specified system.

subcommands.name: describe-namespace
subcommands.description: Gets the latest version of the user's namespace and the public version that it is tracking.

subcommands.name: dissociate-entity-from-thing
subcommands.description: Dissociates a device entity from a concrete thing.

subcommands.name: get-entities
subcommands.description: Gets definitions of the specified entities.

subcommands.name: get-flow-template
subcommands.description: Gets the latest version of the DefinitionDocument and FlowTemplateSummary for the specified workflow.

subcommands.name: get-flow-template-revisions
subcommands.description: Gets revisions of the specified workflow.

subcommands.name: get-namespace-deletion-status
subcommands.description: Gets the status of a namespace deletion task.

subcommands.name: get-system-instance
subcommands.description: Gets a system instance.

subcommands.name: get-system-template
subcommands.description: Gets a system.

subcommands.name: get-system-template-revisions
subcommands.description: Gets revisions made to the specified system template.

subcommands.name: get-upload-status
subcommands.description: Gets the status of the specified upload.

subcommands.name: list-flow-execution-messages
subcommands.description: Returns a list of objects that contain information about events in a flow execution.

subcommands.name: list-tags-for-resource
subcommands.description: Lists all tags on an AWS IoT Things Graph resource.

subcommands.name: search-entities
subcommands.description: Searches for entities of the specified type.

subcommands.name: search-flow-executions
subcommands.description: Searches for AWS IoT Things Graph workflow execution instances.

subcommands.name: search-flow-templates
subcommands.description: Searches for summary information about workflows.

subcommands.name: search-system-instances
subcommands.description: Searches for system instances in the user's account.

subcommands.name: search-system-templates
subcommands.description: Searches for summary information about systems in the user's account.

subcommands.name: search-things
subcommands.description: Searches for things associated with the specified entity.

subcommands.name: tag-resource
subcommands.description: Creates a tag for the specified resource.

subcommands.name: undeploy-system-instance
subcommands.description: Removes a system instance from its target (Cloud or Greengrass).

subcommands.name: untag-resource
subcommands.description: Removes a tag from the specified resource.

subcommands.name: update-flow-template
subcommands.description: Updates the specified workflow.

subcommands.name: update-system-template
subcommands.description: Updates the specified system.

subcommands.name: upload-entity-definitions
subcommands.description: Asynchronously uploads one or more entity definitions to the user's namespace.
